title: SKIMS and DoorDash: Solutions For Every Body, Delivered On-Demand
summary: SKIMS taps DoorDash for its entry into on-demand delivery, bringing its full U.S. retail store footprint and a specialized undergarments and apparel brand to the platform
body_markdown:
Today, DoorDash (NASDAQ: DASH) and SKIMS announced a new partnership to offer on-demand delivery from all SKIMS retail stores across the U.S. Consumers can now shop more than 23,000 styles across shapewear, underwear, loungewear, and more from SKIMS stores on DoorDash, with delivery, on average, in under an hour.* DoorDash is SKIMS’ first on-demand delivery partner, and SKIMS is the first brand on DoorDash to offer a selection spanning undergarments, everyday clothing, and outerwear, bringing its complete wardrobe approach to customers in a new, more convenient way.


Whether it’s Seamless Sculpt shapewear before a big night out, the viral Soft Lounge Long Slip Dress when last-minute plans finally leave the group chat, or the Cotton Poplin pajama set forgotten on a trip, DoorDash makes it easier to get the SKIMS essentials you need when timing matters. SKIMS is built around creating innovative solutions for every body, and DoorDash is built for the moments when you need something now.


> "DoorDash was built on one idea: you should be able to get everything you need in your neighborhood, right now. And increasingly, that's not just dinner, it's what you're wearing to dinner too,” said Shanna Prevé, Chief Revenue Officer at DoorDash. “SKIMS has built an iconic brand that’s become part of so many people’s everyday wardrobes, and that’s exactly what we want to your doorstep. We're proud to be SKIMS' first-ever on-demand delivery partner, giving people a completely new way to shop a brand they already love."


Co-founded in 2019 by Kim Kardashian and Jens Grede, SKIMS is redefining women's underwear, loungewear, and shapewear. As SKIMS continues to expand its physical retail footprint, DoorDash gives consumers another way to shop directly from its stores, bringing on-demand convenience and a new level of comfort to the SKIMS shopping experience.


> “Our focus has always been on understanding what our customers need and finding better ways to serve them,” said Robert Norton, Chief Commercial Officer at SKIMS. “Our partnership with DoorDash gives customers greater flexibility and convenience when shopping SKIMS, making it easier to access the products they want, when they want them. It’s about putting the customer at the center of the experience and providing a solution that works for them’’


DoorDash has continued to expand its retail offering since entering the category in 2021, with tens of thousands of stores now available across apparel, beauty, toys and games, books, auto parts, sporting goods, and more. The growth of retail on DoorDash gives consumers more ways to shop the brands and stores in their neighborhoods, while helping retailers reach more customers through on-demand delivery. Today, there are over half a million retail products eligible for delivery with DoorDash in under an hour, including Beauty, Baby & Kids, Electronics, Household, Personal & Pet Care, and more.**


SKIMS is available on DoorDash from 17 stores across 11 states and Washington, D.C., with nine additional stores coming soon to the platform. To place your first order, open the DoorDash app and search “SKIMS” to order from your local store.
